research_question_and_hypothesis.question: Can the sampled original sm80 cuBLAS kernel, version-only PTX adaptation, and synchronous HBF instrumentation execute on this A100 with identical expected output and intact guards?
research_question_and_hypothesis.hypothesis: All three variants clear the same 32x64 FP32 engineering fixture; staged helper is explicitly unbound and preserves native addresses.

assumptions.USER_CONFIRMED: User requests an execution attempt; no version/hash-bound approval exists yet.
assumptions.DOC_DERIVED: Use archived sample and same compiled artifacts; no operator implementation substitution.
assumptions.INFERRED: Use one small three-arm sample fixture before attempting the unavailable full Llama launcher.

limitations: One sample scal kernel, not the full 16-entry module coverage
